note: Both sets capture the same core facts faithfully: window azimuth 0 for the southern louver, 50-degree solar altitude at fall equinox 12pm, the depth-to-height algorithm, the 25-degree structural bend, and the 1:1 depth-to-height ratio, all with supporting quotes. Set A adds an eighth claim that simply duplicates the truncated-isosceles-triangle shape claim without its 'extruded' condition, which is redundant and trivial rather than new information. Set B is therefore marginally cleaner, though both sets share the same weaknesses: truncated quotes ('windo', 'longit') and a vague 'solar altitude | value' claim with a non-component entity. No claims in either set are misread or invented.
